rapport_notes: Very patient with a customer who apologized repeatedly for interruptions; warm sign-off ("Happy Thursday").
process_discipline_notes: The Meet-Your-Mover / movers-identified-in-advance point was delivered once in the main pricing pitch and then repeated almost verbatim in the post-booking wrap-up ("you will already receive an email from us so that you will know who will be your movers") -- a Stage 1/Stage 2 repeat.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call?" -- asked immediately after the quid pro quo, before any other question.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: "No, not really." -- no concern raised.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "it does not necessarily mean that you need to pay for four hours, even if you just end up less than that" -- pay-less-if-faster covered clearly.

top_strength: Fully personalized estimate anchor (3rd floor with stairs to a 2-story house, 30 minutes away) followed by a clean explicit booking ask.
coaching_note: The Meet-Your-Mover point was delivered twice (once in the pricing pitch, again in the close wrap-up) -- keep the differentiator to a single mention and use the close wrap-up only for logistics not already covered.
